scenario: RMSNorm + Residual Add — Transformer FFN Layer
description: Fused residual add + RMSNorm. Computes: output = rms_norm(input + residual) * gamma. This is the critical normalization layer in every Transformer block, executed 2x per layer (attention-norm + ffn-norm).

baseline_performance.note: 参考: 910B3 上未融合 RMSNorm 85us, 融合后 40us (2.1x). PyTorch eager baseline ~120us.

known_bottlenecks: Two-pass computation (sum_x + sum_x2) causes intermediate UB→GM write
No double buffering between load and compute
BLOCK_SIZE=1024 may not saturate GM→UB bandwidth (k0=6.65KB)
